update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.4 - Parent farming: fix career start getting stuck on Legacy Select
Fixed ----- - The Legacy Select screen and the Support Formation (deck) screen share an identical Auto-Select button graphic that the bot couldn't tell apart. It would tap Auto-Select once on whichever screen it saw first, mark legacy-parent selection as done, and then have no code path left to press Next and leave Legacy Select — the bot got stuck there forever and never started a new career. - Added a fix that presses Next once the Legacy Select screen is detected, so the bot reliably reaches Support Formation and Start Career again. - Added a new "Auto-equip support deck" setting (Parent Farming Settings > Career selection) that taps the Support Formation screen's own Auto-Select to fill owned support-card deck slots, independent from legacy-parent auto-select.
